summary: Fortress Credit Realty Income Trust filed an 8-K to disclose an amendment increasing a repurchase facility with Morgan Stanley from $500M to $750M. The amendment is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No equity or asset purchase/sale, no board recommendation, no strategic review, no activist campaign. The filing simply modifies terms of an existing credit facility, which is ordinary course for a REIT. No deal terms apply as this is not a transformative M&A event.
